(SAUDEL), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 375 NM WEST-NORTHWEST OF KADENA AB, 
HAS TRACKED WESTWARD AT 14 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. ANIMATED 
RADAR IMAGERY INDICATES THE SYSTEM HAS INCREASED SPEED OVER THE PAST 
SIX HOURS, MAKING LANDFALL OVER THE YUHUAN PENINSULA AT 272330Z. TS

THIS SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM
